name: Position Based Fluids
definition: A particle-based fluid simulation method that enforces incompressibility by correcting particle positions based on density constraints, allowing real-time simulation without meshing.
summary: Position Based Fluids is a Lagrangian particle simulation method that enforces incompressibility by iteratively correcting particle positions to satisfy density constraints, distinguishing itself from SPH by treating dynamics as a constraint satisfaction problem rather than solving Navier-Stokes equations.
